name: Neural-Conductive Substrate
description: A biocompatible composite that conducts both electrical and electrochemical neural signals, bridging the gap between electronic circuits and biological nervous tissue. NCS is the enabling material for cyberware neural interfaces, allowing implanted devices to communicate bidirectionally with the brain and peripheral nerves without signal degradation.
story_hooks: Counterfeit NCS from unlicensed labs has been causing rejection cascades in black-market cyberware — the immune response can be fatal.
